title: The Critical Semilinear Elliptic Equation with Isolated Boundary Singularities II
summary: Continuing the work of the second author (2017), we study the Sobolev critical semilinear elliptic equation in the half-space with an isolated boundary singularity and zero Dirichlet boundary condition. This paper addresses two open questions in this setting: the existence of Delaunay type log-periodic solutions posed by del Pino--Musso--Pacard (2007), and the asymptotic classification of singular solutions posed by Bidaut-Véron--Ponce--Véron (2007).
